system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: pmkisan_get_beneficiary_status and pmkisan_track_payment. Here are my details: my aadhaar_number is 100020001364, my beneficiary_id is PMKISAN-BEN-10000001.

function.name: pmkisan_get_beneficiary_status
function.description: Retrieves the current beneficiary status of the farmer including registration_status, ekyc_status, eligibility_status, and linked bank details. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT modify any status or process payments — it is read-only. Fails if the farmer is not registered in PM-KISAN. Returns 'not_registered' if no record exists for the given Aadhaar.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: pmkisan_track_payment
function.description: Tracks the payment processing status of a specific PM-KISAN transaction. Returns payment_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'credited', 'failed') along with transaction reference and failure reasons. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT initiate payments or resolve failures — use pmkisan_resolve_payment_failure for resolution. Fails if no payment record exists for the given beneficiary or transaction reference.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

beneficiary_id.description: Unique identifier of the PM-KISAN beneficiary.

transaction_reference.description: Transaction reference number for a specific payment. Optional — if not provided, returns the latest payment status.
